creator: admin
title: How it works
text:
* ''Storage:'' every tiddler is its own file in a Cloudflare R2 bucket.
* ''Editing:'' a Cloudflare Worker speaks TiddlyWiki's own sync protocol on the admin site.
* ''Reading:'' the public site is the same bucket, served through a custom domain and Cloudflare's cache. No worker runs for a visitor.
* ''Backups:'' every save becomes its own commit in a GitHub repository, through a Cloudflare Queue that retries through outages.
* ''Conflicts:'' two devices editing the same tiddler can't overwrite each other silently. The later save becomes a conflict copy, with an alert.
* ''Offline:'' a service worker keeps the page and the engine on your device, and the tiddlers you have loaded are kept too. On the admin site, changes made offline wait on the device and go out when the network is back.
* ''Plugins:'' plugins installed from the wiki work on both sites, each loaded as its own cached file.

The design, with the alternatives weighed for each choice, is in the project's [[design notes|https://github.com/DesignThinkerer/tiddlywiki-cloudflare/blob/main/docs/design.md]].
